e54ebb3487fc: Start from the text: «Who built the tenement house? Does the text say so?» — no, and that is fine. The passive is needed when the agent is unimportant or unknown.
774ef1c20da4: Show it with an arrow: fasadę → fasada. This is the main mechanism. Ask in which style the passive is more common: news, official texts, history.
e207e5b332ae: Ask them to read the examples aloud. otworzony is the most common mistake among students who already speak fluently.
7f4717963a7a: Treat the oni column separately. Check: «Studenci zostali …» (zaproszeni), «Studentki zostały …» (zaproszone).
441844a8d556: The name was chosen by internet users.
05176f9736dd: The tenement house was bought by a private company.
3c27f8e871c4: I prepared this report / This report was prepared by me.
d6a5a8c6339e: The key trap is using the instrumental for “by me”: it is przez + accusative. Separately: przeze mnie — not przez mnie.
80983a8dcb46: Let the student find a verb without the passive in the text (mieszkali, zatrzymują się).
d08debc99a8a: They sold the tenement house in 2015.
73b6add7e473: They are renovating the old townhouses here.
0d0e6125f898: Do not require active use of -no / -to — that is a separate lesson. Here the student only has to recognise the form in a text (odtworzono).
47eb4c0b6c6f: First show only the English, let the student say it in Polish, then reveal.
ce82fbae63a6: The last trap is for recognising -no/-to forms in a text.
